description: This file defines the ReferenceTypeDescriptor class, which extends ValueDescriptor to handle reference types (such as String and Object) within the MigraDoc DocumentObjectModel. It provides methods to get, set, and check null status of properties on DocumentObject instances.

classes.name: ReferenceTypeDescriptor
classes.description: A descriptor class for reference type properties (String, Object) in the DocumentObjectModel, providing methods to get, set, and null-check these properties.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the property from a DocumentObject, considering flags.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the property on a DocumentObject.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Sets the property value on a DocumentObject to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks whether the property on a DocumentObject is null or not.
